content.title: The Transformer Revolution
content.explanation:
• 1.
• Beginner-friendly explanation: The Transformer is the specific type of neural network that made ChatGPT possible.
• It processes language incredibly well because it looks at entire sentences simultaneously.
• 2.
• Transformers use 'Self-Attention' to instantly make that same connection.

content.title: Transformer Self-Attention
content.explanation: Unlike older models that read word-by-word, see how the Self-Attention mechanism allows every word to instantly connect with every other word to gain full context.

content.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
content.explanation:
• An LLM (like GPT, Gemini,
• or Claude) is essentially a
• massive Transformer model trained on
• a vast portion of the
• internet.

content.question: At their very core, despite their massive size and complexity, what is the single simple task that LLMs (like GPT) are fundamentally doing?
content.correctAnswer: Predicting the next word based on context.
hints: Think about auto-complete on your phone.

stages.title: Choosing the Right Tool
stages.description: You need to predict if a bank transaction is fraudulent based on 50 numeric columns (amount, time, distance from home). Should you use a Random Forest or fine-tune an LLM?

choices.text: Fine-tune an LLM. It's the most advanced technology.
choices.outcome: Wrong! LLMs are terrible at structured numerical tabular data and are vastly overkill for this.

choices.text: Use a Random Forest or XGBoost model.
choices.outcome: Correct! Classic ML algorithms still heavily dominate structured tabular data tasks in speed, cost, and accuracy.
